title: ReSPO: Reshaped Sequence Policy Optimization for Gradient Starvation in Off-Policy Learning
abstract_first: Reinforcement learning from verifiable rewards (RLVR) frequently reuses rollouts across multiple policy updates, increasing the mismatch between the current policy and the data-generating policy.
